meeting_title: TAMPA CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL CALL MEETING
disclaimer: THIS FILE REPRESENTS AN UNEDITED VERSION OF REALTIME CAPTIONING WHICH SHOULD NEITHER BE RELIED UPON FOR COMPLETE ACCURACY NOR USED AS A VERBATIM TRANSCRIPT. ANY PERSON WHO NEEDS A VERBATIM TRANSCRIPT OF THE PROCEEDINGS MAY NEED TO HIRE A COURT REPORTER.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: WELL, GOOD RAINY AFTERNOON, EVERYBODY. WELCOME TO TAMPA CITY COUNCIL AND OUR SPECIAL CALLED MEETING. I WOULD LIKE TO CALL THIS MEETING TO ORDER AND ASK THE CLERK TO CALL THE ROLL.

segments.speaker: CHARLIE MIRANDA
segments.text: HERE.

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: HERE.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: HERE.

segments.speaker: NAYA YOUNG
segments.text: HERE.

segments.speaker: BILL CARLSON
segments.text: HERE.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: HERE.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.text: WE HAVE A PHYSICAL QUORUM.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: JUST A LITTLE RUN OF THE SHOW OF HOW WE ARE GOING TO DO THINGS. WE WILL DO AN APPROVAL OF THE AGENDA. SO IF COUNCIL MEMBERS -- RIGHT NOW IN THE AGENDA IS HOW IT IS SET AS OF NOW. WE WILL DO PUBLIC COMMENT ON THE AGENDA ITEM. THAT WILL BE ABOUT APPOINTMENT, AND APPOINTMENT ONLY OF A SPECIALLY CALLED MEETING. MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THREE MINUTES TO SPEAK OF THE APPOINTMENT. YOU DON'T HAVE TO USE YOUR WHOLE THREE MINUTES. YOU CAN SAY I SUPPORT SOMEBODY. YOU ARE PERFECTLY ENTITLED TO USE YOUR WHOLE THREE MINUTES. I KNOW THERE ARE FACES THAT I DON'T NORMALLY SEE. WHEN I CALL YOUR NAME -- YOU SHOULD HAVE FILLED OUT ONE OF THESE CARDS. WHEN I CALL YOUR NAME, YOU WILL COME UP AND LINE UP AGAINST THE WALL. I USUALLY CALL THREE AT A TIME. FIRST PERSON WILL COME TO THE DAIS. WHEN YOU START, YOU ALWAYS START WITH YOUR NAME. THE LIGHT WILL TURN GREEN, AND YOU WILL HAVE THREE MINUTES. WHEN THE LIGHT TURNS YELLOW, A 30-SECOND WARNING. WHEN THE LIGHT TURNS RED, MID-BELL OR MID-SENTENCE, YOU STOP TALKING WHEN THE LIGHT TURNS RED. WE WILL DECLARE THE AGENDA AND THEN PUBLIC COMMENT. IN A WAY THE AGENDA IS SET -- UNLESS COUNCIL DECIDES TO CHANGE THAT NOW. AFTER PUBLIC COMMENT, WE WILL HEAR FROM THE CANDIDATES TO FILL THE DISTRICT 7 POSITION. EACH CANDIDATE, AS OF RIGHT NOW, WILL BE AFFORDED TWO MINUTES TO SPEAK TO COUNCIL. WITH THAT BEING SAID, WE ALL RECEIVED THE RESUMES AND APPLICATIONS. WE HAD A WEEK TO REVIEW THOSE. A LOT QUESTIONS HAVE BEEN ASKED AND ANSWERED IN THAT PROCESS. WITH THAT BEING SAID, WHY DON'T WE TALK ABOUT THE AGENDA. COUNCIL MEMBER MANISCALCO FIRST --

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: ARE WE ALLOWED TO ASK QUESTIONS OF THE CANDIDATES?

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: RIGHT NOW, THAT IS NOT ON THE AGENDA. IF SOMEONE WANTS TO DO THAT, THERE WILL NEED A CHANGE TO THE AGENDA.

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: I WOULD LIKE TO MAKE A MOTION -- I HAVE ONE QUESTION TO ASK OF ALL THE CANDIDATES. I WOULD LIKE TO MAKE A MOTION THAT WE ASK QUESTIONS.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: SECOND.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: CAN I MAKE SUGGESTION. IF WE DO THAT, ONE OR TWO -- AND ASK THE SAME QUESTION TO ALL OF THEM AND MAYBE GIVE THEM A LITTLE EXTRA TIME DURING THEIR PUBLIC COMMENT DURING THEIR SPEECH. THEN THEY CAN ANSWER -- EVERYBODY CAN ANSWER THE SAME QUESTIONS EVERY SINGLE TIME.

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: I JUST HAVE ONE THAT WILL NEED FIVE SECONDS.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: WHAT WOULD BE A PROPOSED QUESTION? I HAVE A MOTION AND A SECOND. WOULD YOU LIKE FRAME THE QUESTION?

segments.speaker: GUIDO MANISCALCO
segments.text: WILL YOU BE RUNNING FOR CITY COUNCIL. THAT MEANS ANYTHING. ANY OF THE RACES. NOT DISTRICT 7. WILL YOU BE RUNNING FOR CITY COUNCIL?

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: UNANIMOUS CONSENT TO ASK THAT QUESTION? HEARING NO OPPOSITION, WE WILL ADD THAT TO THE QUESTION. ANY OTHER QUESTIONS? ANYBODY ELSE? COUNCILWOMAN HURTAK?

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: I THOUGHT YOU HAD A QUESTION? NO, SORRY. I MISUNDERSTOOD. I DON'T HAVE A QUESTION.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THERE IS ONLY ONE QUESTION SO I THINK WE CAN KEEP IT AT TWO MINUTES UNLESS THERE IS SOME OBJECTION. ALL THE APPLICANTS, YOU HAVE YOUR TWO FULL MINUTES AND ANSWER THE QUESTION OF COUNCIL, ARE YOU PLANNING TO RUN FOR CITY COUNCIL OR CITY COUNCIL DISTRICT 7? YES, MA'AM.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: I JUST WANTED -- ONE THING YOU DIDN'T TALK ABOUT FOR PUBLIC COMMENT. IF YOU HAVEN'T SIGNED UP FOR PUBLIC COMMENT YET, AND YOU WANT TO, THERE ARE FORMS OUT THERE.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: I DID.

segments.speaker: LYNN HURTAK
segments.text: I DON'T KNOW IF PEOPLE KNOW THEY ARE STILL THERE FOR JUST A FEW MORE MINUTES.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: AS SOON AS WE START PUBLIC COMMENT, IT GETS SHUT OFF. THANK YOU SO MUCH, COUNCILWOMAN. WITH THAT BEING SAID, A MOTION TO APPROVE THE AGENDA WITH THE AMENDMENT. A MOTION FROM COUNCIL MEMBER MANISCALCO. SECONDED FROM COUNCIL MEMBER MIRANDA. AYES HAVE IT. THIS IS THE BEGINNING OF PUBLIC COMMENT. IF YOU HAVEN'T FILLED OUT THE PUBLIC COMMENT CARD, THE OPPORTUNITY TO NOW IS CLOSED. FIRST THREE SPEAKERS ARE STEPHANIE POYNOR, BRITTANY PANTON, AND PATRICIA KEMP. STEPHANIE POYNOR, YOU ARE THE FIRST SPEAKER. BRITTANY AND PAT, IF YOU COME AGAINST THE WALL, PLEASE. START WITH YOUR NAME, PLEASE. I WANT TO POINT OUT A LOT OF PEOPLE WHO APPLIED FOR THIS JOB THAT I NEVER HAVE SEEN BEFORE. I HOPE THEY ARE DOING THE HOMEWORK. I HOPE YOU KNOW THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A LEGISLATIVE AND A QUASI-JUDICIAL HEARING. IF YOU DON'T, GO HOME. THIS ISN'T THE TIME. IF YOU DON'T KNOW THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A WORKSHOP AND A REGULAR HEARING, GO HOME. THIS ISN'T THE TIME. IF YOU ARE OFFENDED BY WHAT I AM SAYING, GO HOME, BECAUSE THIS ISN'T THE TIME. [LAUGHTER] IF YOU ARE NOT READY TO ANSWER THE PHONE 24 HOURS A DAY, SEVEN DAYS A WEEK WHEN PEOPLE CALL YOU BECAUSE THEY NEED HELP, GO HOME. I THINK THERE IS A LOT OF PEOPLE HERE WHO THINK THIS IS A PART-TIME JOB. IT'S NOT. I DON'T EVEN SIT UP THERE ON THE DAIS. I DON'T HAVE TO MAKE THE DECISIONS, AND I SPEND BETWEEN SIX AND EIGHT HOURS A WEEK OUTSIDE OF HERE PAYING ATTENTION TO WHAT IS GOING ON. IF YOU ARE NOT ALREADY DOING THAT, GO HOME. IT SOUNDS -- DON'T WASTE EVERYBODY'S TIME. JUST PACK UP AND GO HOME. THANK YOU. HAVE A GOOD DAY.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU, MISS POYNOR. FOR EVERYBODY IN THE AUDIENCE, AS AMUSING AS I FIND STEPHANIE POYNOR, WITH THE DECORUM, WE ARE NOT ALLOWED TO HAVE PUBLIC FEEDBACK. LAUGH TO YOURSELF. NO APPLAUSE. NO CLICKING. WE ARE TRYING TO CONCENTRATE AND GIVE THE PERSON AT THE PODIUM WHETHER YOU AGREE OR DISAGREE, FIND THEM FUNNY OR AWFUL, WE TRY TO BE NEUTRAL. BRITTANY, START WITH YOUR NAME. AND I'M HERE TO LET YOU KNOW I SUPPORT ROBIN FOR THIS SEAT THAT SHE IS RUNNING FOR. BECAUSE YOU HAVE MANY THINGS. SHE IS SOMEONE WHO HAS BEEN IN THE COMMUNITY, AND WE NEED SOMEONE WHO KNOWS WHAT IS GOING ON FROM THE GROUND UP AND BE ABLE TO MAKE THE DECISIONS FOR US. A LOT OF THE TIMES, WE CHOOSE PEOPLE WHO DO NOT ENGAGE WITH THEIR COMMUNITY UNTIL THEY RUN FOR THAT SEAT AND MOVE TO THAT COMMUNITY. SO JUST SPEAKING A LITTLE ABOUT IT, MISS ROBIN COMES HERE EVERY WEDNESDAY BEFORE HER JOB STARTS. AND ADVOCATES FOR THE WORKING-CLASS PEOPLE, MIDDLE-CLASS PEOPLE WHO ARE STRUGGLING. IF IT IS HOUSING, IF IT IS HEALTH CARE, IF IT IS WHATEVER. MISS ROBIN IS THE PERSON I WANT TO SEE GET THAT SEAT. THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU VERY MUCH. NEXT SPEAKER IS THE HONORABLE PAT KEMP FOLLOWED BY PAMELA GOMEZ AND VALERIE BULLOCK. AND I DID NOT -- I WAS NOT PREPARED TO SPEAK. DIDN'T KNOW WE COULD SPEAK. I WAS JUST GOING TO COME DOWN AND SUPPORT PATRICIA A. ALONZO. BECAUSE I KNOW SO MANY OF THE CANDIDATES PERSONALLY, AND I WANT TO SAY THIS IS NOT ABOUT ANY OF THE OTHER CANDIDATES OR ABOUT, YOU KNOW, NOT SUPPORTING THEM. BUT IT IS REALLY ABOUT SUPPORTING PATRICIA ALONZO. THE WAY I GOT TO KNOW PATRICIA, I WAS CAMPAIGNING WITH HER DURING THE LAST CAMPAIGNS UP IN NORTH HILLSBOROUGH COUNTY. AND I DIDN'T KNOW HER BEFORE THAT. I WAS SUPER IMPRESSED BY HER. I WAS TAKEN ABACK BY HOW SMART SHE WAS, HOW MUCH SHE LEARNED ON THE JOB, HOW ENGAGED SHE WAS WITH THE COMMUNITY, HOW MUCH SHE CARED, AND HOW MUCH SHE RELATED TO PEOPLE AND PEOPLE RELATED TO HER. AND I JUST THOUGHT, OH MY -- YOU KNOW, SHE DIDN'T GET ELECTED TO WHAT SHE WAS RUNNING FOR. BUT I THOUGHT, WE HAVE -- WE HAVE GOT TO HAVE THAT WOMAN REPRESENTING US IN SOME CAPACITY BECAUSE SHE IS SO GOOD. AND SO I FEEL PARTIALLY RESPONSIBLE. I WAS VERY MUCH IN HER COURT AND TRYING TO PUSH HER TO RUN BECAUSE I THINK SHE WILL MAKE AN EXCELLENT CITY COUNCILOR WHETHER IT COMES HERE TODAY OR IN A FEW MONTHS, BUT I AM UP HERE TO SAY MY TWO CENTS FOR PATRICIA. I AM SO IMPRESSED. AND FOR THOSE OF YOU WHO DON'T KNOW, SHE IS FLUENT SPANISH SPEAKER, FIRST LANGUAGE I THINK MAYBE. SIGN LANGUAGE. AND SHE IS JUST A SUPER COMMUNICATOR AND A SUPER SMART PERSON. SO I WOULD LOVE TO SEE HER ON THIS COUNCIL.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU, PAT. [APPLAUSE] NO, NO. [GAVEL SOUNDING] PLEASE, NO CLAPPING. WE DON'T BOO, AND WE DON'T CLAP. PAMELA GOMEZ FOLLOWED BY VALERIE BULLOCK. I'M HERE IN SUPPORT OF ROBIN LOCKETT. ROBIN -- PAMELA GOMEZ. I'M HERE IN SUPPORT OF ROBIN LOCKETT AS A COMMUNITY ADVOCATE, AND I CAN TELL YOU THAT ROBIN HAS BEEN LONG STANDING FOR ALL ISSUES EQUITY, BELONGING, INCLUSION, AND YOU CAN NAME IT. ROBIN IS NOT JUST THE ADVOCATE THAT YOU HAVE SEEN TIME AND TIME AGAIN HERE, BUT SHE IS DEFINITELY SOMEONE WHO HAS MORE THAN JUST PUBLIC SERVICE AT HEART TO BE AS EQUALLY SEATED AS YOU ARE UP THERE. I KNOW THERE IS A LOT OF RIGHTFULLY DESERVING CANDIDATES BEHIND ME, BUT WHAT MAKES ROBIN STAND OUT IS THAT SHE KNOWS COMMUNITIES, AND MORE THAN THAT, SHE KNOWS HOW POLITICS WORK AND KNOWS THAT AS WELL. SO I THINK SHE IS MORE THAN QUALIFIED FOR THIS ROLE AND BEYOND. THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU, PAMELA. VALERIE FOLLOWED BY DR. ANGELA SCOTT. FOLLOWED BY -- OH, MY GOODNESS. NOREEN? NAZEEN PAL? VALERIE, YOU CAN GO AHEAD. I AM GLAD I AM NOT UP HERE WHERE YOU ARE AT TODAY, BECAUSE THIS IS A VERY HARD DECISION YOU HAVE TO MAKE. I AM IN SUPPORT OF PATRICIA ALONZO. I MET PATRICIA A WHILE BACK, AND I LIKE HER DEMEANOR, HER HUMBLENESS, AND SOMEHOW SHE CAN REACH PEOPLE IN ALL THE COMMUNITIES, AND SHE IS VERY, VERY SMART, NOT ONLY FROM GOING TO COLLEGE AND BEING A DOCTOR, BUT SHE IS VERY SMART IN THE INTRICACIES OF HOW THE COMMUNITY WORKS AND WHAT THE COMMUNITY NEEDS. AND SHE IS MY CHOICE. THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU, VALERIE. THANK YOU FOR YOUR BREVITY. DR. ANGELA SCOTT FOLLOWED BY NAZEEN. MY NAME IS DR. ANGELA SCOTT. I'M HERE FOR ROBIN LOCKETT. AND I HAVE SENT ALL OF YOU A LETTER JUST ON OUR BEHALF, MY HUSBAND AND I, WITH OUR COMPANY ALL GROWN HUMAN CAPITAL. WE ARE ALL ABOUT GROWING PEOPLE, AND THAT IS WHAT ROBIN IS ALL ABOUT. ROBIN IS A SERVANT LEADER. HER SERVANT IS HER LEADERSHIP, HER RESUME. A FEW THINGS I WOULD LOVE TO READ ABOUT ROBIN. ROBIN DOES LEAD WITH A SMILE. A SERVANT LEADER. SHE IS A REGIONAL DIRECTOR FOR THE FLORIDA RISING IN THE TAMPA BAY REGION. SHE EQUIPS RESIDENTS TO ADVOCATE FOR THEIR OWN PRIORITIES WITH THE FOCUS ON HOUSING, FAVORABILITY, AND EQUITABLE SOLUTIONS. THE VERY ISSUES THAT FAMILY ACROSS THE TAMPA BAY AREA ARE CONCERNED WITH. I HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO CANVAS FOR HER AND KNOCKING ON DOORS, HEARING WHAT THE PEOPLE HAVE TO SAY. HOUSING IS IMPORTANT TO THEM. AND SHE IS DOING THE WORK FOR THEM. SHE MODELS THE BEHAVIOR OF A PERSON WHO IS CONCERNED ABOUT THE CITIZENS. SHE SHOWS UP HERE WEEKLY FOR MEETINGS. SHE -- SHE MAKES COMMENTS ON ISSUES THAT MATTER AND MAKE AN IMPACT FOR THE COMMUNITY. AS IT ALREADY HAS BEEN SAID, SHE KNOWS THE COMMUNITY, NOT JUST IN WHERE SHE LIVES BUT THROUGHOUT THE TAMPA BAY AREA. SHE IS AN INSPIRATION FOR US ALL, BECAUSE IT IS ABOUT PARTICIPATION. IT IS NOT ABOUT POWER TO HER. IT IS ABOUT JUSTICE AND INJUSTICE AND MAKING THE RIGHT DECISIONS. SHE LISTENS. SHE LISTENS TO WHAT YOU HAVE TO SAY, AND SHE THINKS ABOUT THE POLICIES. AS A BOARD MEMBER, I AM CONFIDANT THAT THE TAMPA BAY HILLSBOROUGH AREA, THEY WILL BENEFIT FROM HER AS SHE HAS SERVED ON SEVERAL BOARDS ALREADY HERE IN TAMPA BAY AREA, SUCH AS THAP AND OTHER BOARDS. SHE IS ENGAGING. ROBIN ENGAGES EVERYONE AT THE TABLE, WORKING FAMILIES, YOUNG PEOPLE, SENIORS, FAMILY LEADER, FAITH-BASED LEADERS, BUSINESS OWNERS, AND NEIGHBORS. SHE INVOLVES EVERYONE. AND THIS IS SOMEONE THAT YOU WANT TO COLLABORATE WITH AND WORK WITH DURING THIS TIME AS YOU GET READY TO MAKE AN ELECTION, BUT SHE IS THE BEST CANDIDATE TO DATE TO SIT IN A DISTRICT SEAT. THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU SO MUCH. NOREEN FOLLOWED BY KURT THORSON. NAZEEN PAL. WANT TO MAKE SURE YOU HAVE THE RIGHT PERSON.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THAT IS CORRECT. I'M HERE TO KINDLY ASK YOU TO APPOINT PATRICIA ALONZO. NOT ONLY WILL SHE REPRESENT DISTRICT 7, BUT SHE WILL REPRESENT EVERY CITIZEN IN TAMPA. AS A PUBLIC HEALTH PRACTITIONER MYSELF, I UNDERSTAND HOW SHE WORKS IN THE COMMUNITY AND UNDERSTANDING THE HOLISTIC NEED OF EVERYONE HERE. THANK YOU VERY MUCH.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: NEXT SPEAKER IS KURT. I WOULD KEEP MY WORDS BRIEF. WELCOME FOR THIS SELECTION. IT IS NOT AN ELECTION, BUT A SELECTION BEFORE THE ELECTION IN MARCH. MY SENTIMENTS, WHOEVER THIS COUNCIL CHOOSES, IT SHOULD BE A SHORT-TERM SOLUTION VERSUS A LONG-TERM ELECTION WHERE THE ENTIRE DISTRICT AND CITY OF TAMPA SHOULD HAVE A SAY WHO TO FILL THAT SEAT BY FORMER COUNCIL MEMBER VIERA. SO TO SUM IT UP, I BELIEVE THAT THIS ONE SHOULD BE LESS THAN FOUR MONTHS UNTIL THE ELECTION AND SHORT-TERM FOR SOMEONE NOT RUNNING FOR REELECTION. LET THE VOTERS AND THE PEOPLE OF TAMPA DECIDE THAT INSTEAD OF INSTALLING SOMEONE FOR A COUNCIL OF SIX OR MORE YEARS PLUS. IT SHOULD BE LESS THAN FOUR MONTHS.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU, KURT. BEV FOLLOWED BY SURGRET FOLLOWED BY BETSY BRATEN. DISTRICT 7 AND HOW IT ADDRESSES A LOT NEIGHBORHOODS NOT JUST THE LARGER NEW TAMPA. WE LIKE TO SAY WHERE I LIVE IN FOREST HILLS, IT BEGINS THERE. WE HAVE THE OUTLOOK NEIGHBORHOOD. ALL THE ONES IN OUR AREA. SO THE PERSON THAT YOU CHOOSE TO REPRESENT US, WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE THAT THEY CAN BRANCH OUT AND VISIT US AND KNOW OUR SPECIAL NEEDS. WE WENT THROUGH A LOT AFTER MILTON, AND AT THAT TIME, OUR CURRENT REPRESENTATIVE LUIS HELPED US TO EXPLAIN WHAT HAD NOT HAPPENED IN THE REST OF TAMPA. YOU GUYS WEREN'T AS AFFECTED BY THE HURRICANE AND THE FLOODING, AND IT DID TAKE A MOUNTAIN OF IMPACT FOR US TO GET THE HELP WE NEEDED. WE HAVE PEOPLE WHO ARE STILL RECOVERING TODAY. I DON'T WANT TO HARP ON THAT, BUT I WANT TO TALK OF THE IMPACT OF NEIGHBORHOODS. SOUTH TAMPA'S NEEDS ARE DIFFERENT. AND THIS DISTRICT IS HEAVILY POPULATED BY THE PEOPLE IN NEW TAMPA. SO PLEASE PICK SOMEONE WHO CAN, YOU KNOW, REACH OUT TO US. I THINK THAT PEOPLE FORGET THAT WE ARE MORE OF A WORKING-CLASS NEIGHBORHOOD. THERE ARE A LOT OF RETIRED PEOPLE IN OUR AREA WHOSE BUDGETS ARE STRETCHED. AND I WOULD LIKE TO THINK THAT WE ARE A NEIGHBORHOOD THAT IS A HIDDEN TREASURE HERE, BUT MANY HAVE DISCOVERED IT RECENTLY. AND WE ARE INVITED BY PEOPLE WITH MORE MONEY THAT CAN TAKE OVER THE HOUSING THAT IS AVAILABLE THERE AND TURN IT INTO SOMETHING THAT WE DO NOT SEE FOR OUR NEIGHBORHOOD AS SINGLE-FAMILY, ZONING, THAT TYPE. WE ARE ALWAYS HAVING TO BE THANKFUL FOR THE SERVICES THAT THE CITY DOES GIVE US. AND SO WE WANT A PERSON THAT WOULD HELP US REACH THOSE RESOURCES. AND WE HAVE FOUND THAT IN OUR LAST COUNCILMAN. AND I WOULD LIKE TO JUST PUT THAT IN THE BACK OF YOUR MIND AS YOU ARE THINKING ABOUT IT. THINK THE WORD "NEIGHBORHOODS." THANK YOU.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU, BEV. SURGRET FOLLOWED BY BETSY. I'M HERE ON BEHALF OF ROBIN LOCKETT. I AGREE WITH COMMENTS MADE EARLIER --

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: YOUR NAME? I WANT TO SAY WHEN YOU MAKE YOUR DECISION, I WOULD LIKE TO SEE THIS KIND OF PRESENCE EVERY THURSDAY AS WELL. BUT WHEN YOU MAKE YOUR DECISION, GET SOMEBODY THAT'S IDENTIFIABLE WITH THE COMMUNITY AND SOMEBODY WHO ACTUALLY PICKS UP THEIR PHONE WHEN YOU CALL AND WILL CALL YOU BACK. ROBIN DOES DO THAT. DESPITE HER PLEASANT DEMEANOR, SHE HAS A FERVOR FOR THE PEOPLE ,AND WHEN YOU MAKE YOUR DECISION, KEEP THAT IN MIND. I SAY THAT AS A DISABLED AMERICAN VETERAN BUT ALSO AS ONE OF THE REGULAR PEOPLE OF THE CITY OF TAMPA. WITH THAT BEING SAID, I'M HERE IN SUPPORT OF ROBIN LOCKETT AND HOPEFULLY YOU GIVE HER TREMENDOUS CONSIDERATION DESPITE THE FACT SHE DIDN'T ATTEND THE GREATEST INSTITUTION OF THE CITY OF TAMPA, JEFFERSON HIGH SCHOOL.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: PAUSE FOR A MOMENT AND LOOK AT YOUR TELEPHONE. NO BEEPING, NO RINGING, NO DINGING, AND NO TELEPHONES. OKAY. WE ARE ALL SURE THAT WE ARE OFF? BETSY FOLLOWED BY REVA IMAN. GOOD MORNING. START WITH YOUR NAME, PLEASE.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: YES.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: YOU DON'T HAVE TO LEAN DOWN. IT WILL PICK YOU UP. BECAUSE THEY CAN'T HEAR ME BACK THERE. MY NAME IS BETSY BRATEN.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: HOLD ON, WE WILL RESET YOUR TIME.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: HOLD ON ONE SECOND. EVERYBODY IN THE AUDIENCE. EVERYBODY THAT IS TALKING PLEASE STOP TALKING BECAUSE WE CAN'T HEAR THE SPEAKER. GIVE THEM THE RESPECT THIS THEY DESERVE. EVERYBODY DESERVES TO BE HEARD IF THEY ARE AT THE PODIUM. PLEASE REMAIN SILENT. THOSE WHO DON'T KNOW, THE ACOUSTICS IN THIS ROOM ARE REALLY GOOD. EVEN IF YOU WERE WHISPERING IN THE BACK, THOSE VOICES AMPLIFY AND COME OVER HERE. START AGAIN WITH YOUR NAME. PAT ALONZO. SHE IS ALWAYS OUT WORKING IN THE COMMUNITY. I HAVE SEEN HER AROUND FOR FIVE YEARS. SHE ALWAYS DOES ANSWER HER PHONE. SHE IS ALSO GOOD TO CALL WHEN YOU ARE HAVING A MEETING, AND YOU NEED SOMEONE FOR AMERICAN SIGN LANGUAGE. SHE IS ALWAYS THERE TO HELP. AND SO PAT ALONZO, THAT IS WHO I WOULD LIKE. SHE WOULD BE GREAT.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU VERY MUCH. MISS IMAN. AFTER MISS IMAN, BISHOP MICHELLE PATTY. I'M IN DISTRICT 7. I HAVE THE PLEASURE OF VOLUNTEERING WITH MISS ROBIN LOCKETT. I CAN HONESTLY SAY SHE HAS BEEN TO EVERY CITY COUNCIL MEETING THAT YOU HAVE HAD IN THE PAST, AND SHE IS A PEOPLE PERSON, A COMMUNITIES PERSON. JUST AS A MEMBER -- YOU SEE HER DOWN HERE. AND NOT JUST HER FIGHT SHE IS FIGHTING. AS A MEMBER, WE COME TOGETHER EVERY YEAR. WE PICK THREE ISSUES THAT WE HAVE. WE VOTE ON THOSE ISSUES. AND ONCE WE VOTE ON THOSE ISSUE, MISS ROBIN'S JOB IS TO HELP US FIGHT THOSE ISSUES. THE ISSUES YOU SEE ARE NOT HER ISSUES WHAT WE VOTE ON AS MEMBERS OF THAT ORGANIZATION. BUT AS A PERSON THAT I KNOW PERSONALLY, WE HAVE PROBLEMS ACROSS THIS COMMUNITY. SHE HAS BEEN ACROSS EVERY ONE OF Y'ALL'S DISTRICTS. WE HAVE BEEN FROM TALLAHASSEE TO WASHINGTON TO ORLANDO, AND SHE HAS GIVEN AWESOME -- JUST HELP TO MANY DIFFERENT STATES AS WELL. TO SAY SHE IS VERY WELL FUNDED TO BE IN THAT SEAT, SHE IS THE PERFECT PERSON BECAUSE SHE IS ABOUT THE COMMUNITY. IT IS NOT ABOUT HER. SHE IS ABOUT THE PEOPLE. AND THAT IS WHAT YOU ARE VOTING FOR, FOR THE PEOPLE. VOTING -- FOR YOU ARE VOTED IN TO BE A VOICE FOR THE PEOPLE. SHE IS ABOUT THAT. THAT IS HER THROUGHOUT HER EVERY BONE. SO I WISH YOU CONSIDER HER FOR THAT SEAT IN DISTRICT 7. THANK YOU. [INAUDIBLE]

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: BECAUSE OF THE WEATHER, IF YOU ARE HERE AND YOU WANT TO SPEAK WITH PUBLIC COMMENT, YOU NEED TO FILL OUT ONE OF THESE CARDS. YOU HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO ASK FOR ONE OF THE CARDS, AND WE WILL CLOSE IT OFF FOR REAL THIS TIME. CLOSE OFF PUBLIC COMMENT. SO BISHOP MICHELLE B. PATTY FOLLOWED BY ASHLEY. MY NAME IS BISHOP MICHELLE B. PATTY. THE APPOINTMENT SHOULD NOT BE BASED ON ONE ISSUE WHETHER THE APPLICANTS SUPPORTS THE RAISE OR NOT. I AM IN SUPPORT OF ROBIN LOCKETT BECAUSE SHE HAS BEEN CONSISTENT IN HER COMMITMENT TO SERVING THE COMMUNITY. SHE WAS SUCCESSFUL IN HELPING TO GET THE MINIMUM WAGES RAISED TO INCREASE TO $15 AN HOUR. SHE WAS SUCCESSFUL IN ORGANIZING PEOPLE TO GO TO TALLAHASSEE AND WASHINGTON TO LOBBY ON BEHALF OF THE HOMELESS, THE WORKING POOR, AND OUR FORGOTTEN VETERANS. THE PAST FEW YEARS, ROBIN HAS SERVED AS THE EIGHTH COUNCIL PERSON WITHOUT COMPENSATION. SHE HAS SHOWN UP. SHE HAS SUPPORTED MANY OF YOU. AS YOU RAN FOR OFFICE, SHE WAS THERE FOR YOU, BRINGING THE COMMUNITY ALONG WITH HER. THE COMMUNITY IS VERY SUPPORTIVE OF THIS APPOINTMENT, BECAUSE THIS APPOINTMENT SHOULD SPEAK VOLUMES TO WHO YOU ALL ARE AND WHAT YOUR CONCERNS ARE WITH THE COMMUNITY. SO IF YOU REALLY VALUE THE COMMUNITY AND YOUR CONSTITUENTS, YOU WILL GET SOMEBODY WHO CAN HIT THE GROUND RUNNING ON DAY ONE. NO OTHER PERSON THAT I KNOW OF THAT HAS SAT HERE DAY AFTER THURSDAY AFTER THURSDAY SUPPORTING THE COUNCIL AND THE PEOPLE IN THE COMMUNITY. THAT SHOULD COUNT FOR SOMETHING IF YOU ARE SINCERE ABOUT ELECTING A PERSON THAT IS GOING TO SERVE THE COMMUNITY. THERE ARE TOO MANY ISSUES AT STAKE HERE IN THE CITY OF TAMPA. WITH AMENDMENT 3 PASSING, NOW WE HAVE ISSUES WHERE WE ARE GOING TO FIND FUNDING. THAT IS WHY WE NEED TO HAVE SOMEONE THAT KNOW ABOUT FUNDING, KNOWS ABOUT FLOODING, KNOWS ABOUT HURRICANES. AND THAT IS ROBIN LOCKETT. I WAS BORN AND RAISED RIGHT HERE IN THE CITY OF TAMPA JUST A FEW BLOCKS AWAY FROM THIS CITY HALL. ROBIN LOCKETT AND I, WE DON'T AGREE ON EVERYTHING. BUT GUESS WHAT WE DO AGREE ON, THAT WE WILL SERVE OUR COMMUNITY AND SERVE IT TO THE BEST OF OUR ABILITIES. SO IF YOU ARE REALLY SINCERE ABOUT WHAT YOU ARE DOING AND ABOUT WHAT THIS APPOINTMENT MEANS, THEN IT IS A NO BRAINER. IT SHOULD BE ROBIN LOCKETT. I DON'T HAVE ANYTHING AGAINST THE OTHER APPLICANTS, BUT I KNOW HER WORK. AND HER WORK SPEAKS FOR ITSELF, LOUD AND CLEAR. SHE COULD HAVE BEEN DOING LIKE A LOT OF OTHER PEOPLE WHERE THEY DON'T WIN A RACE OR IF THEY ARE NOT COMING DOWN TO GET SOMETHING FOR THEMSELVES, NOT SHOW UP. BUT ROBIN LOCKETT HAS SHOWED UP EVERY TIME. SHE HAS FURTHERED THE WORK. AND NOW SHE DESERVES A SEAT AT THE TABLE ON BEHALF OF THE PEOPLE OF HILLSBOROUGH COUNTY.

segments.speaker: ALAN CLENDENIN
segments.text: THANK YOU, BISHOP. NOPE, PLEASE DON'T. ASHLEY MORROW FOLLOWED BY CHLOE CONEY. GOOD MORNING, MISS ASHLEY. MY NAME IS ASHLEY MORROW, AND I WOULD LIKE SO SUPPORT ROBIN LOCKETT. I DO NOT SPEAK FOR THE MILLENNIAL GENERATION, BUT I AM PART OF THE MILLENNIAL GENERATION. PRIOR TO ME EVEN COMING UP HERE, I MET ROBIN THROUGH DOING WORK IN THE COMMUNITY. AND THEN WHEN I CAME HERE FOR FIRST TIME, SHE WAS A FAMILIAR FACE. AND WHAT I WILL GIVE ROBIN IS WHEN SHE SEES THE DIRECTION THAT YOUR ADVOCACY IS GOING, SHE GIVES YOU GUIDANCE.
